'''Stalkerix''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Manteeny]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Serrabloom]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Less a fighter, more an artist. Stalkerix aims to make every defeated opponent fall with grace."

Stalkerix is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A light pink and white orchid mantis with green wings and green accents on its front legs and face. Interestingly, it only has four legs, unlike [[Manteeny]] which has six legs.

Stalkerix's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces light pink with sky magenta, and green becomes aquamarine.

==Evolution Trial==
Stalkerix's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Serrabloom]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Stalkerix to increase stats 3 times.
* Shoot 20,000 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Old Bio: "The academic community haven't reached a conclusion about what 'certain things' it needs to consume."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Researchers say it's important for Stalkerixes to eat certain things to evolve, but they're not sure exactly what."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Attracts prey with beauty, only to strike the moment they become captivated. If there is no audience, Stalkerix may grow sulky."
